current_role: Former U.S. representative from Georgia; anti-war populist activist
summary: Marjorie Taylor Greene, a Georgia Republican elected to the House in 2020, was one of Trump's most prominent allies before breaking with him over the Iran war. She called for his removal via the 25th Amendment, said she was done with the GOP, and in August 2026 joined Tucker Carlson, Thomas Massie and Joe Kent in urging Carlson to run for president.
